2607.13594.title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
2607.13594.paper_summary: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. We reframe the problem as a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE} and instantiate it with Safety Sentry, a lightweight guard model whose inference reduces to a single decoding call. A single decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint be re-positioned across deployments of differing risk tolerance without retraining. Safety Sentry outperforms a broad set of open-weight and frontier closed-source baselines on overall accuracy and safety-related recall, while controlling both directional error rates simultaneously.
2607.13594.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人透過工具調用在現實世界環境中行動，而單一的錯誤判斷行動可能會造成不可逆的傷害。標準的安全措施是一個守衛模型，將每個提議的行動標記為安全或不安全，但這種二元觀點混淆了兩個不同的決策：該行動本身是否有害，以及根據用戶的上下文該行動是否合適。它還是在行動類別的粒度上運作，而不是單個實例，這會產生例行的中斷，侵蝕自主性並訓練用戶忽略最重要的警報。我們將問題重新框架為每個實例的三向路由決策，選擇 {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE}，並用 Safety Sentry 實現，這是一個輕量級的守衛模型，其推理簡化為單次解碼調用。單一的解碼時間閾值使得一個固定的檢查點能夠在不同風險容忍度的部署中重新定位，而無需重新訓練。Safety Sentry 在整體準確性和安全相關的召回率上超越了一系列開放權重和前沿封閉源基準，同時控制兩個方向的錯誤率。
